name: Aibani Yahiya
headline: I help B2B SaaS founders generate 20–30 sales calls/month through an effective LinkedIn inbound strategy.

sections.bio:
Are you a B2B SaaS founder struggling to generate leads from LinkedIn?

You're not alone. Many founders face challenges like:

- Inconsistent posting
- Converting content into leads
- Lacking a systematic approach to content

That's where I come in.

I specialize in helping B2B SaaS founders create a streamlined inbound system that transforms your LinkedIn presence into a lead-generating machine:

- Profile Optimization: Craft a profile that converts visitors into leads.
- Content Strategy: Develop a strategy that attracts your ideal clients.
- Engaging Content: Write compelling content that sparks conversations, not just likes.
- Sales Calls: Turn engagement into consistent sales calls.

The goal is not to go viral but to establish a reliable system that delivers predictable leads every month.

If you're tired of:

- Posting without results
- Relying on cold outreach
- An unpredictable pipeline

Let’s change that.

DM me “LEADS” to discover how we can make this work for you.

posts.text:
What kills a warm lead in DMs?

I sent 20 DMs a day. 

Every one got ignored.

Zero reply. Not one client.

I thought my offer was bad.

• I pitched too fast, message one or two
• I never asked a single question
• I sounded like every other DM they'd already skipped
• I was talking, not listening

Here's what actually worked after that:

• Ask a real question first
• Let them talk about their problem
• Say nothing about your offer yet
• Pitch only when it feels right

Don't sell in the first message.

PS: Ever sent DMs a day with zero replies?

99% of my followers don't know this about me.

 I failed at 2 businesses before landing on LinkedIn.

 But it wasn't because I couldn't do it:

 - I wasn't interested in one
 - I didn't believe in the other
 - I wasn't emotionally invested in either

 So I quit both.

 Then I found LinkedIn ghostwriting. Stuck to it.

 I liked it, committed to it, and eventually found results.

 For months, nothing was happening. But I kept going.

 Then it clicked. It changed things for me.

 Stop quitting so soon.

 PS: What do you think, was it affiliate marketing?

I lasted 4 months not closing a single deal.

- It was rough
- I wasn't getting results
- It was stressful
- No one around to help
- Every day felt like starting over

I sat down to write every day, not knowing if it'd work.

I kept going anyway.

2 months later, I finally got the algorithm.

- I didn't know how to help people
- I had to drop bad habits
- I had to learn from scratch
- I wrote a lot of posts that flopped

Then one post worked. Then another.

Today:

- I'm working with clients
- I'm seeing real results
- I'm happy putting in the hours
- I enjoy the work, not just the money

Took 6 months Worth every hour.

Harsh client truth:

liking your proposal means nothing.

>You need the agreement signed
>You need the deposit paid
>You need a start date fixed
>You need him to actually show up after saying yes

I closed a client last week.

 Sent the proposal.

 He liked it. Said he was ready to start.

Next day, he blocked me.

No message. No reason. Just gone.

Stop believing, I'm interested is a yes.

The only real yes is money in your account.

PS: Still don't know why he blocked me.

3 weeks ago, I stopped posting and flew to Hyderabad.

 That trip led to:
 - Sharper communication
 - Better writing habits
 - A break that didn't feel like falling behind

 Worked with 17 people, different states, different mindsets, for 2 days straight.

 Here's why it worked:

 - No phone, just the work
 - Two days was enough to actually learn
 - Everyone thought differently

 The best part, I didn't plan any of it.

 I just showed up and paid attention.

 PS: More on what I picked up - soon.
